text.en:
Section 7 of the Presidential Decree No. 3 dated September 26, 1972, is hereby amended as
"Sec. 7. The National Economic Development Authority (N.E.D.A.) shall formulate and issue rules and
regulations designed to accelerate implementation or prosecution of public works projects, including the
manner of, and priority in, expenditures of funds or the allocation thereof, either by the national or local
governments, or by any other agency of the government, the necessity of bidding or when such bidding would
be dispensed with, and the organization of a Council or other office or agency which may become or be
deemed necessary to effectively and efficiently prosecute the infrastructure program and other programs of the
government, prescribing the powers and functions of such office or agency.
Until, however, the National Economic Development Authority (N.E.D.A.) has promulgated such rules and
regulations, and, notwithstanding provisions of any existing law, rule or regulation to the contrary, and
irrespective of the source of funds, all public works projects with a cost of Two Hundred Thousand
(P200,000.00) Pesos or less may be done by administration by the Bureau or agency concerned without
benefit of public bidding subject to the provision of Section fourteen, hereof. Public Works project with a cost
of more than Two Hundred Thousand (P200,000.00) Pesos, shall, after public bidding, be awarded by
contract. If there are no responsible bids for the project or the bids are higher than the government estimate on
the cost of the project, or in case the project may be prosecuted by administration by the bureau or agency
concerned after securing the approval of the Department Head. In case of urgent necessity or emergency,
projects may be prosecuted by administration without benefit of public bidding upon representation by the
bureau or agency concerned, subject to favorable recommendation of the Department Head and approval by
the President of the Philippines.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 10th day of November in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-two.
